text: The system shall allow a registered user to log in using email and password. After three consecutive failed attempts, the account shall be locked for 30 minutes.
The system shall allow users to reset their password via a link sent to their registered email. The reset link shall expire after 15 minutes.
The user shall be able to search for products by keyword. If no results are found, the system shall display a 'no results' message and suggest popular products.
The system shall allow a user to add a product to the shopping cart. The same product added twice shall increase the quantity instead of creating a duplicate entry.
During checkout, the user shall enter a valid 16-digit card number. Invalid or expired cards shall be rejected with an appropriate error message.
The user shall be able to update their profile information. Changing the email address shall require re-verification of the new email.
The system shall allow file uploads in JPG and PNG formats only. Files larger than 5 MB shall be rejected with an error message.
The search field shall accept a minimum of 2 characters. If the user enters special characters, the system shall sanitize the input before searching.
The user shall be able to book an appointment by selecting a date and time. Past dates shall not be selectable, and a confirmation shall be shown after booking.
The payment module shall validate the card expiry date. Expired cards and cards with insufficient funds shall be rejected with distinct error messages.
The user shall be able to remove an item from the shopping cart. Removing the last item shall display an empty-cart message.
The user shall be able to enable or disable email notifications. A daily digest shall be sent at 8 AM if at least one notification is pending.
The user shall change their password only after providing the current password. The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
The system shall automatically log out the user after 15 minutes of inactivity. Any unsaved form data shall be preserved as a draft.
Only verified purchasers shall be able to write a product review. Reviews shall be limited to 500 characters and shall appear after moderation.
The user shall be able to cancel an order within 30 minutes of placement. After cancellation, a refund shall be initiated to the original payment method.
The user shall be able to save up to 3 delivery addresses. One address shall be marked as the default and used for checkout unless changed.
New accounts shall be activated through a verification link sent by email. The link shall expire after 24 hours, after which a new link can be requested.
When two-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall send a 6-digit OTP to the user's phone. The OTP expires after 5 minutes and 3 wrong attempts shall block login.
A product that is out of stock shall not be purchasable. The user shall be able to register for a notification when the product is back in stock.
A discount coupon shall be applicable only within its validity period and only if the order total exceeds the coupon's minimum order value. Only one coupon may be used per order.
Search results shall be paginated with 20 items per page. If the user navigates beyond the last page, an empty state message shall be shown.
The user shall be able to sort products by price and rating, and combine sorting with category filters. The selected combination shall persist across searches in the session.
The application shall support English and Chinese. The selected language shall persist across sessions and apply to all menus and messages.
Comments containing banned words shall be rejected automatically. The user shall see which word caused the rejection.
The user shall be able to download their order history as a CSV file. Only the account owner shall be able to download this data.
Each API key shall be limited to 100 requests per minute. Exceeding the limit shall return a 429 status code with a retry-after header.
A partially filled form shall be automatically saved as a draft every 60 seconds. The draft shall be restored when the user returns within 7 days.
The system shall generate a monthly usage report as a PDF on the first day of each month. If generation fails, an email alert shall be sent to the administrator.
Guest checkout shall be available without creating an account, but a valid email address is required to receive the order confirmation.
A user shall be able to cancel a subscription at any time. Access shall continue until the end of the current billing period and no partial refund shall be given.
Only users with the admin role shall be able to delete user accounts. Every deletion shall be recorded in an audit log with the admin's identity and timestamp.
The user shall be able to filter orders by date range. The start date shall not be later than the end date, and the range shall not exceed one year.
When inventory drops below 10 units, a low-stock alert email shall be sent to the warehouse manager once per day until restocked.
The mobile application shall support biometric login using fingerprint or face recognition. After 5 failed biometric attempts, PIN entry shall be required.
